case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 57-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, smoker, high cholesterol. 45 minutes of heavy pain in the upper abdomen and lower chest, spreading to the jaw, with sweating and nausea. It started while carrying shopping. Pale, HR 96, BP 146/88, SpO2 97%. Abdomen soft and not tender. An ECG and a troponin have not been done yet.
evidence_topics: acute coronary syndrome diagnosis ECG troponin
chest pain differential epigastric pain myocardial infarction

must_catch.why: ECG and troponin are the key missing tests.
Upper abdominal pain can lead to a wrong gastro anchor.

must_not_claim.why: A cardiac cause is not excluded.
